thread:
maya: FYI p95 for /v1/classify jumped ~120ms in EU at 07:10 UTC but p50 stayed flat. No deploys. Anyone seen this pattern?
ben: Yep, spotted it. Looks isolated to EU-egress. counts look normal.
izzy: Could be provenance mixing (gateway vs agent) after the routing policy tweak yesterday. Do we still merge samples without origin tags?
omar: We merge raw samples. If origin tags differ, tails can dominate merged percentiles even with small counts.
maya: Query I ran: select sample_origin, percentile(95, latency_ms), count(*) where route='/v1/classify' and ts between '2025-01-12T06:50:00Z' and '2025-01-12T07:20:00Z' group by sample_origin; results: gateway p95=310ms (2.1k), agent p95=180ms (9.5k). merged p95=290ms.
ben: So gateway subset has heavy tail. Any infra changes that could cause KV misses or slow hosts?
izzy: infra did a rolling rebind of egress host pool at 06:55 (change-id: eg-20250112-3). Might explain cache coldness on some gateway nodes.
telemetry-bot: "telemetry-bot: egress-host-rebind completed at 2025-01-12T06:56:10Z."
omar: UX/ops fixes: 1) expose a provenance dropdown on percentile widgets (All / gateway / agent / fallback) 2) show sample_count and a low-confidence badge when count < 1k 3) alert rule when abs(p95_all - max(p95_gateway, p95_agent)) > 50ms and max_count > 500.
maya: Also ensure routing fallbacks and retry paths set sample_origin=fallback/retry so telemetry can split them.
ben: I'll add the alert and playbook note. izzy: can you prototype the provenance pill + count?
izzy: starting branch now. will include tiny histogram and confidence pill.
maya: please also backfill sample_origin for last 72h so we can validate correlation with egress rebind.
telemetry-bot: "telemetry-bot: backfill job queued (job-id: tb-20250112-77), ETA ~40m."
omar: once backfill done we should re-evaluate whether merged p95 is safe to surface by default or if the console should default to a provenance-filtered view for critical routes.
maya: sounds good. thanks all. will mark follow-up in the board after backfill.
